title: InstEditSeg: Instruction-Driven Image Editing for Polyp and Skin Lesion Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.02004v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate segmentation of polyps and skin lesions is pivotal for clinical diagnosis, yet existing methods struggle with low contrast, ambiguous boundaries, and cross-domain distribution discrepancies. Discriminative networks and most diffusion-based segmentation approaches predict standalone binary masks, leaving the visual priors of large-scale pretrained generative models largely unexploited. We propose InstEditSeg, a unified generative framework that reformulates medical segmentation as an instruction-driven image editing problem. Instead of emitting a mask, the model renders a color-coded overlay on the original image, conditioned on a textual instruction, so that the edited output aligns with the natural image distribution learned by latent diffusion models and mitigates the domain gap between natural and medical imagery. To recover fine anatomical structures, we introduce DINOv3 as an auxiliary visual encoder and a DINO Feature Gu

translated_title: InstEditSeg：面向息肉与皮肤病变分割的指令驱动图像编辑
translated_abstract: 息肉和皮肤病变的准确分割对临床诊断至关重要，然而现有方法在低对比度、模糊边界以及跨域分布差异方面仍面临困难。判别式网络和大多数基于扩散模型的分割方法预测的是独立的二值掩码，未能充分利用大规模预训练生成模型的视觉先验。我们提出InstEditSeg，这是一个统一的生成式框架，将医学分割重新表述为指令驱动的图像编辑问题。该模型不再输出掩码，而是在文本指令的条件下，在原始图像上渲染彩色编码的叠加层，使编辑后的输出与潜在扩散模型学习到的自然图像分布保持一致，从而缓解自然图像与医学影像之间的域差距。为了恢复精细的解剖结构，我们引入DINOv3作为辅助视觉编码器以及DINO特征引导（DINO Feature Gu...，原文此处截断）。
tldr: InstEditSeg将医学图像分割重新表述为指令驱动的图像编辑任务，通过在原图上渲染彩色叠加层以对齐自然图像分布，缓解自然图像与医学影像间的域差距，并借助DINOv3视觉编码器恢复精细解剖结构，从而提升息肉与皮肤病变的分割效果。
en_tdlr: InstEditSeg reformulates medical segmentation as instruction-driven image editing by rendering color-coded overlays on original images to align with natural image distributions and mitigate the domain gap, while leveraging DINOv3 as an auxiliary visual encoder to recover fine anatomical structures for polyp and skin lesion segmentation.
